form.label: BigFix FillDB Health & Performance
form.description: Monitors database connectivity, buffer I/O health, and dropped endpoint reports.

search.query: index="bigfix" sourcetype="bigfix:root:filldb" "Database Error" | rex field=_raw "Database Error:\s+(?<error_message>.*)" | eval error_message=coalesce(error_message, _raw) | stats count by error_message | rename error_message AS "Database Error Details", count AS "Occurrences" | sort - Occurrences

index="bigfix" sourcetype="bigfix:root:filldb" ("Discarding message from computer" OR "Unable to parse chunk") | rex field=_raw "computer (?<computer_id>\d+)" | rex field=_raw "(discarding:\s+|Client report\s+)(?<error_reason>[^\.\(]+)" | eval error_reason=coalesce(error_reason, "Signature or Parsing Error") | search computer_id="*" | stats count AS "Dropped Reports", latest(_time) AS "Latest Rejection" by computer_id, error_reason | rename computer_id AS "Computer ID", error_reason AS "Rejection Reason" | fieldformat "Latest Rejection" = strftime('Latest Rejection', "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | sort - "Latest Rejection"
index="bigfix" sourcetype="bigfix:root:filldb" "File IO error" "bufferdir" | timechart count AS "I/O Read Failures"

index="bigfix" sourcetype="bigfix:root:filldb" "FillDB version" "starting" | rex field=_raw "^(?<timestamp>[^-]+-\d{4})\s+--\s+(?<pid>\d+)\s+--\s+FillDB version\s+(?<version>[\d\.]+)\s+starting" | eval sortable_time = strptime(timestamp, "%a, %d %b %Y %H:%M:%S %z") | sort - sortable_time | table timestamp, pid, version | rename timestamp AS Timestamp, pid AS "Process ID", version AS "FillDB Version"
